title: Corporate return and distribution schedule
html:
Corporate return and distribution schedule

Reconcile taxable income and a shareholder distribution under the supplied simplified assumptions.

Required responses

metadata.taxLawPeriod: 2026; exercise-specific rates and limits are stated in each case

fields.label: Dividend portion of the distribution
fields.explanation: The distribution is a dividend to the extent of the stated earnings and profits.

fields.label: Gain after dividend and basis recovery

exhibits.title: Corporate income
exhibits.html: Book income $500,000 includes $20,000 tax-exempt interest and $15,000 nondeductible expenses. Additional allowed tax depreciation exceeds book depreciation by $25,000. No other differences apply. Use a 21% tax rate.

exhibits.title: Distribution
exhibits.html: A single cash distribution is $80,000. Applicable earnings and profits are $50,000; stock basis is $20,000. No special distribution rule applies.

explanation:
Corporate taxable income

$500,000 − $20,000 + $15,000 − $25,000 = $470,000.

Tax before credits

$470,000 × 21% = $98,700.

Dividend portion of the distribution

The distribution is a dividend to the extent of the stated earnings and profits.

Gain after dividend and basis recovery

$80,000 − $50,000 − $20,000 = $10,000.
